entries.041109085ca5da7d: LogStare Inc., a consolidated subsidiary, is a business that trains and dispatches information security personnel. It recruits applicants aspiring to become information security engineers, conducts practical training based on SecuAvail's training program, and then dispatches them to client companies. For existing customers of the information security business, the company also proposes combining network-type services with engineer dispatch. In the fiscal year ended March 2026, revenue from external customers was ¥249 million.

entries.4985c3c412510c5f: This is the business undertaken by the company and its consolidated subsidiary LogStare Inc. The company provides "NetStare," an integrated security operations service that monitors customers' networks 24 hours a day, 365 days a year, and "AI-SOC," a next-generation security operations service in which AI guides the process from detecting security risks to determining response measures. LogStare Inc. develops and sells products including "LogStare," a security operations platform that combines network monitoring and log management. In the fiscal year ended March 2026, revenue from external customers was ¥1,030 million, which accounts for the core of the entire Group.
